unsupported_policy: Leave component null and do not calculate item PIRD
anti_circularity: Severity and probability prompts exclude recurrence and persistence
evidence_level: 5 when calibrated evidence is sufficient; otherwise missing
global_score: 0.70 * mean category score + 0.30 * maximum category score
gold_standard_scope: Human labels validate signal inclusion, surveillance relevance and evidence sufficiency
limitation: The existing human Gold Standard does not contain 1-5 severity and probability labels because those components were introduced later with PIRD
